label: Diagram 2.1
caption: Diagram 2.1 Universal toilet sign (all rights reserved to BS ISO 7001:2023)
description: The drawing is a sign, shown as a white rectangular field. A thin green line runs along its top edge, and a solid green band fills the bottom. In the centre of the white area stand two black human pictograms of similar height, placed side by side. The left figure has a circular head, two arms angled downward from the shoulders, and a trapezoidal skirt from which two short legs project. The right figure has a circular head, two arms angled downward, and two straight, widely spaced legs. In each of the four corners of the white area there is a small registration mark made up of a short horizontal tick and a short vertical tick. The green band at the bottom carries white text reading "Diagram 2.1 Universal toilet sign (all rights reserved to BS ISO 7001:2023)". No dimensions or scale are shown.
